create_MixtureOfTwo: create a MixtureOfTwo distribution from two component distributions with a scalar probability weight
sample_MixtureOfTwo: sample from a MixtureOfTwo distribution using a PRNG key and sample count
compute_log_prob_MixtureOfTwo: compute the log probability of a value under a MixtureOfTwo distribution
index_MixtureOfTwo: index into a MixtureOfTwo distribution by batch shape to get a sliced MixtureOfTwo
inspect_MixtureOfTwo_properties: inspect the event_shape, batch_shape, prob_a, and prob_b properties of a MixtureOfTwo instance
